_doc: OVL-ELECTRON-PIN (F-044, research 0046 R4). Hash pin for the Electron runtime of the desktop client, fetched by tools/electron_pin.py (AshLight's own fetch code, AshLight User-Agent) instead of electron's install.js, and unpacked to app/node_modules/electron/dist. version must equal the electron entry of app/package.json. zip_sha256 was read from the release's SHASUMS256.txt and re-computed from the downloaded zip; exe_sha256 and exe_size were computed from electron.exe inside that zip, on the verified date. eol is the release line's tentative end of life from Electron's public release schedule (research 0046 S2). A missing or malformed value makes the tool refuse; never guess one. No absolute paths here.
